title: These 3 Free Tools Scrape Any Site For You
description:
Three open-source tools that replace paid scraping services, and each solves a different problem.

ScrapeGraph AI (29,977 stars) takes a URL and a plain-English sentence and returns structured data, so you never write a selector. Agent Reach (75,854 stars, MIT) wraps free readers for Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, LinkedIn and Instagram behind one command with no paid API keys. Scrapling (76,722 stars) re-finds elements after a site changes its layout, which is what normally breaks a scheduled scraper.

Worth knowing: free tools do not override a platform's terms or privacy law. Stick to public business data and respect robots.txt.

Get every install command and the full lead-list workflow here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kbAcm_kOsBXkbjs9m8Tn8iojUIEhzFAXxWrUEJrt2yw/edit?usp=sharing
